name: composed-retrieval-original-four-v1
initialization: Draw every key, tied value/readout, query rotation and initial-state angle independently from the uniform distribution on [-pi,pi) with MT19937 seeded by the model seed. Initialize predecessor bias, recency and every signed offset to zero.
sampling: Shuffle all original training examples each epoch with MT19937 seeded by model seed + 10000, retaining the tail batch. Use every supervised position with its original multiplicity. Average ordinary complete-vocabulary CE over those positions.
optimizer: Mini differentiates the complete minibatch CE. Forward-only Mini queries complete minibatch CE on both sides of each selected scalar, clips gate perturbations to [0,1] and divides by the actual displacement. Compute all estimates before updating. Adam has a clock per visited coordinate. Project only the two gates after each update.
forward_schedule: With MT19937 seeded by model seed + 20000, shuffle separate cycles in parameter order for the key, value, rotation, predecessor and signed-offset tables. Each update visits the next 16 coordinates in each cycle, or its entire table if smaller. Visit every initial-state angle, key scale, recency and both gates every update.
freeze: Train 24 endpoints independently in each of two fresh builds of one commit. Seal all 48 before scoring any held-out prefix. Compare endpoints, optimizer evidence, initial and final complete raw f64 logits, original metrics and independent replay.
scoring: Preserve every original split and original selection criterion. Separately require at least 99 percent raw-object and exact-sequence accuracy on every applicable held-out split for every seed in both modes. Report predictions by training input and positive-target exposure, and binding by queried pair exposure. Keep all negative or failed cases.
